title: Living with Migraine: Treatment Experiences and Preferences
intro: Thank you for your interest in this survey about migraine. It takes approximately 10 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.

rules.reason: Respondent is under 18 years of age.

questions.text: Have you ever been diagnosed with migraine by a healthcare professional?
Do you or does anyone in your household work in any of the following industries?

rules.reason: Household works in a conflicting industry.

questions.text: On average, how many days per month do you experience migraine headaches?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 31.

rules.reason: Chronic migraine (15+ headache days) quota is full.

questions.text: Which of the following do you currently use to treat a migraine attack when it happens?

options.label: Non-drug approaches (rest, dark room, ice, caffeine)

questions.text: Are you currently using a preventive (daily or monthly) treatment for migraine?

options.label: No, but I am considering one
No, and I am not interested

questions.text: Overall, how satisfied are you with your current approach to managing migraine?
How much do migraines interfere with your daily activities?
In your own words, what is the most frustrating part of managing your migraines?
